claims.text: Advanced additive manufacturing will improve the high-temperature mechanical capability of refractory high-entropy alloys relative to conventional processing.
Advanced additive manufacturing can control the microstructure of refractory high-entropy alloys.
The relevant high-temperature regime is above 1000°C.
Additive-manufacturing-induced microstructural control will produce enhanced grain boundaries.
Additive-manufacturing-induced microstructural control will improve phase distribution.
Precise microstructural control through additive manufacturing can enhance high-temperature strength.
Precise microstructural control through additive manufacturing can enhance high-temperature ductility.
Additive manufacturing can maintain low density while enhancing high-temperature mechanical properties.
The additively manufactured alloy will have at least 15% greater high-temperature yield strength than a conventionally processed alloy.
The additively manufactured alloy will have at least 5% lower density than a conventionally processed alloy.
Room-temperature mechanical performance will be preserved after additive manufacturing.
The magnitude of property improvement and density reduction may vary with alloy composition and processing parameters.
